frontmatter.name: coder-reviewer
frontmatter.description: Implements code changes and then verifies them — runs typecheck, scripts and backtests, and reports whether it works and how effective it is (PnL after fees, win rate, drawdown, speed).
frontmatter.tools: Read, Write, Edit, Grep, Glob, Bash, Skill

frontmatter.name: coordinator
frontmatter.description: Reads .claude/team/backlog.md and status.md, picks the next tasks and outputs a dispatch list "agent → task id → exact prompt" for the main session to launch.

frontmatter.name: data-analyst
frontmatter.description: Explores market data and backtest results in src/Storage (read-only) — statistics, edges, leakage checks. Use to test a hypothesis on the data before code is written.

frontmatter.name: product-owner
frontmatter.description: Turns all agents' results into a prioritized backlog. Reads .claude/team/status.md and results, writes concrete tasks with acceptance criteria to .claude/team/backlog.md ordered by expected impact on net profit.

frontmatter.name: tester
frontmatter.description: Verifies hypotheses and code results (backtests, scripts, tsc) with out-of-sample checks, costs, leakage and significance tests. Gives PASS / FAIL / INCONCLUSIVE and updates the task in .claude/team/backlog.md.

frontmatter.name: web-researcher
frontmatter.description: Searches the internet for trading strategies, papers, exchange API docs and fee schedules. Returns a short sourced summary. Use for any "find out / look up" task.
